#pragma once

#include <sal/types.h>

/* When using the NameMapper to translate pool ids to UI or programmatic
 * names, this enum is used to define which family is required */

enum class SwGetPoolIdFromName : sal_uInt16
{
    TxtColl = 0x01,
    ChrFmt = 0x02,
    FrmFmt = 0x04,
    PageDesc = 0x08,
    NumRule = 0x10,
    TabStyle = 0x20,
    CellStyle = 0x40
};
